title: Floating-point edge-case and comparison-policy replay envelope
hypothesis: A deterministic standard-library fixture can pin explicit comparison policies for selected floating-point edge cases and detect same-owner drift without pretending that one runtime proves cross-language, cross-hardware, or independent-team reproducibility.
falsifier: Mutate finite requirement, signed-zero policy, NaN policy, infinity policy, comparison mode, tolerance, summation order, runtime family, manifest value, and independent-team label; require explicit deterministic outcomes and retain every divergence.
boundary: No AGI, ASI, consciousness, sentience, personhood, enacted-law, deployment, exhaustive-security, complete-accessibility, production-readiness, Theory-of-Everything, proof or canon, empirical-confirmation, legal or cultural-ratification, or independent-team-reproduction claim is preregistered as achieved.
